**7B.5 Research Note: Joko Widodo, 2024**

Overall read: **mixed, leaning negative**. Jokowi kept at least one very strong technocrat in place and the macro team still looked professionally run. But on the political side, 2024 evidence shows **loyalists, party fixers, and transition-smoothing appointees** around him more than a clean meritocratic bench.

**Positive / professional**
- **Indonesia markets rattled by election uncertainty, finance minister’s future**. Reuters via Investing.com. 2024-02-01. [URL](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/analysisindonesian-markets-rattled-by-election-uncertainty-finance-ministers-future-3289355) | Reuters described Sri Mulyani as a highly regarded finance minister and said the finance ministry kept working normally despite succession noise. This is strong evidence that Jokowi retained a competent professional with real standing. **QIDs:** 7B.5, 7B.4
- **IMF staff completes 2024 Article IV mission to Indonesia**. IMF. 2024-06-14. [URL](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/14/pr24221-imf-staff-completes-2024-article-iv-mission-to-indonesia) | IMF said Indonesia’s fiscal and monetary frameworks remained prudent, credible, and shock-ready. That supports the reading that key economic posts were still staffed and managed in a technocratic way. **QIDs:** 7B.5
- **Trenches: Relentless Reformer Sri Mulyani Indrawati**. IMF. 2024-12. [URL](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/fandd/issues/2024/12/trenches-relentless-reformer-sri-mulyani-indrawati) | IMF said Sri Mulyani strengthened macro foundations, broadened the tax base, capped subsidies, and enforced high standards. This is strong direct evidence of a competent-professional appointment at the center of government. **QIDs:** 7B.5, 7B.4
- **Indonesia economy projected to remain resilient**. World Bank. 2024-06-24. [URL](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/24/indonesia-economy-projected-to-remain-resilient) | The World Bank credited Indonesia’s robust macro framework and prudent, credible policy. This is indirect but useful support for a technocratic governing core. **QIDs:** 7B.5

**Negative / loyalist-heavy**
- **Outgoing Indonesian president gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo**. Reuters via Investing.com. 2024-08-19. [URL](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/outgoing-indonesian-president-widodo-names-prabowo-aides-to-cabinet-3576652) | Jokowi appointed people close to Prabowo into cabinet roles in a transition-smoothing move. Reuters framed this as a loyalty-heavy reshuffle rather than pure merit selection. **QIDs:** 7B.5, 7B.3
- **Jokowi seeks Golkar takeover to retain decade-long influence**. Reuters via The Jakarta Post. 2024-03-20. [URL](https://www.thejakartapost.com/indonesia/2024/03/20/jokowi-seeks-golkar-takeover-to-retain-decade-long-influence) | Reuters reported Jokowi trying to install a loyal ally to lead Golkar and keep influence after office. That is direct evidence of network preservation, not neutral professional staffing. **QIDs:** 7B.5, 7B.3
- **Analysis - a decade of Jokowi: Indonesia’s democracy icon leaves illiberal legacy, critics say**. Reuters via ThePrint. 2024-10-14. [URL](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/) | Reuters’ end-of-term analysis described patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity. Broadly, that supports the view that loyalty and political network management outweighed clean meritocracy. **QIDs:** 7B.5, 7B.3, 4B.2
- **Jokowi left strong growth and infrastructure, but also patronage and dynastic politics**. Reuters via ThePrint. 2024-10-14. [URL](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/) | Same underlying Reuters analysis, useful as background: the government’s professional economic outputs coexisted with a loyalty-heavy political machine. **QIDs:** 7B.5, 7B.4
- **World Bank Group debars PT. LPPSLH Konsultan**. World Bank. 2024-07-10. [URL](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/10/world-bank-group-debars-pt-lppslh-konsultan) | The Bank found overbilling and improper hiring of a project official’s family member in a Jokowi-era project. That is not a direct cabinet appointment case, but it is concrete evidence of non-merit favoritism inside state-linked implementation. **QIDs:** 7B.5, 7B.4

**Search gap**
- I did **not** find strong 2024 proof that Jokowi’s core ministries were dominated by family members, cronies, or donors in the literal cabinet sense.
- The clearest positive evidence is **sector-specific and technocratic**, especially finance.
- The clearest negative evidence is **political patronage and loyalist placement** around the presidency and coalition, rather than a full cabinet of obvious cronies.
- So the best synthesis is: **competent professionals remained in important economic posts, but Jokowi’s broader governing style still relied heavily on loyalists and influence-preserving appointments.**
